top_signals.title: Goldman Sachs Steps Up Warnings on Diesel as Wars Curb Flows
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. stepped up warnings of tightness in global refining driven by wars in the Middle East and between Moscow and Kyiv, with the bank more than doubling its forecasts for profits from making diesel.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Emerging-Market Stocks Fall as Warsh Stokes Fed Rate-Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: Emerging-market equities and currencies declined as investors weighed the prospect of higher US interest rates following hawkish comments from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Black Sheep on Hong Kong's F&B Sector
top_signals.summary: Syed Asim Hussain, founder of Black Sheep, provides an update on the Hong Kong-based restaurant group's business and shares his outlook for the financial hub's food and beverage sector. He speaks on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)
